title: Brooke won't quit

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Hey, this is the moment. The moment that your whole life turns around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, this is the moment. The moment that your whole life turns around.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: I... can't believe you really said that out loud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... can't believe you really said that out loud.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Hey! Get ready for me to blow your mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Get ready for me to blow your mind.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: So listen, shut up a minute ok. I got to tell you about generative personal insert fiction. GPIF! You've heard of it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So listen, shut up a minute ok. I got to tell you about generative personal insert fiction. GPIF! You've heard of it?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: So imagine your favorite fictional content. Animated, serial, comicized. Whatever. Imagine the hero in these stories... was you! Wild, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So imagine your favorite fictional content. Animated, serial, comicized. Whatever. Imagine the hero in these stories... was you! Wild, right?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: This is personalized storytelling beyond anything you've ever seen, man! I recommend a comic. That's the best way to experience GPIF.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is personalized storytelling beyond anything you've ever seen, man! I recommend a comic. That's the best way to experience GPIF.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: You're not getting it. But don't worry, it's simple really. And also revolutionary. We offer the ultimate fictional escapism. Award-winning storytelling, but based on your life!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not getting it. But don't worry, it's simple really. And also revolutionary. We offer the ultimate fictional escapism. Award-winning storytelling, but based on your life!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Of course you do! My publishing company will create a comic that makes you feel like a hero. And if you feel like a hero, you can become one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course you do! My publishing company will create a comic that makes you feel like a hero. And if you feel like a hero, you can become one!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Right! And if my publishing company makes you feel like a hero, then you can become one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! And if my publishing company makes you feel like a hero, then you can become one!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Of course you're a hero! Now if I we generate a GPIF about you, you do get ONE choice. Which genre of comic do you want to star in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course you're a hero! Now if I we generate a GPIF about you, you do get ONE choice. Which genre of comic do you want to star in?

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Is that a type of pirate? Whatever. The AI will know how to write it. Let's create your legend matey!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a type of pirate? Whatever. The AI will know how to write it. Let's create your legend matey!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Really? I always wanted to be invisible... Anyway, I'm sure the AI is gonna come up with a great arch enemy for you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? I always wanted to be invisible... Anyway, I'm sure the AI is gonna come up with a great arch enemy for you!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: And are you gonna multi-class? Wait, no, scratch that. I don't think the AI can handle that complexity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And are you gonna multi-class? Wait, no, scratch that. I don't think the AI can handle that complexity.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: Sure. I mean... AI... Ai-lbert. My co-writer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. I mean... AI... Ai-lbert. My co-writer.

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: All names are made up. No refunds. I'll go generate... uh... write your comic series now. I'll send you the bill with issue 1!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All names are made up. No refunds. I'll go generate... uh... write your comic series now. I'll send you the bill with issue 1!

nodes.speaker: Brooke Hazard
nodes.text: No refunds! I'll get Ai-lbert to get writing. I'll send you the bill with issue one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No refunds! I'll get Ai-lbert to get writing. I'll send you the bill with issue one!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you want to write a comic about me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want to write a comic about me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you want to write a comic about me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you want to write a comic about me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want a comic about my life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want a comic about my life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want a comic about my life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want a comic about my life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not a hero. I'm just a regular person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not a hero. I'm just a regular person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not a hero. I'm just a regular person.
